cards.title: Specialist brains
items: Orchestrator reads file state and dispatches product, research, taste/design, engineering, growth, quality and launch specialists
Research and taste-research inspect sources and local video; UX and design-director produce wireframes, three concepts and an original prototype
Frontend and backend implement the locked design; growth maintains SEO data and validates internal links
Ship verifies QA, accessibility, security and performance; domain-ops handles only owner-approved DNS/TLS/mail work

cards.title: Decisions and gates
items: Stage files in D:/UiBuildProj/<slug>/docs/ are the contract; each agent writes a handoff JSON
G1 approves scope and wireframes; G2 locks design; G2.5 approves the exact local experience before S4
G3 requires retained test evidence; G3.5 approves the exact build and target before any external preview or production deployment
Three design directions use isolated forks; only the critic compares them

cards.title: Brain and tool boundaries
items: brain/domains.json routes tasks; resources and patterns have provenance, rights and trust scores
brain/tools.json controls tool availability; Agent Browser explores live pages and Playwright runs the G3 browser matrix
Jev offers shadow hints; offline brain-evaluator compares router versions; only owner review can promote
BusinessOS edits only manifest-listed SEO files through an owner-approved PR and separate publish approval
